description: This file defines a RideState class for managing ride-related state in a Flutter app using ChangeNotifier. It includes properties for distance, ride request status, destination info, and current address, with getter and setter methods that notify listeners on changes.

classes.name: RideState
classes.description: A central state management class for ride-related data, extends ChangeNotifier to notify UI components of changes.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Updates the ride distance and notifies listeners.

methods.name: requestRide
methods.description: Sets the ride requested flag to true and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationAddress
methods.description: Sets the destination address string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationCoords
methods.description: Sets the destination latitude and longitude and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setCurrentAddress
methods.description: Sets the current address string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all ride state properties to initial values and notifies listeners.
